entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: The night view... Couldn't think of[n]anything better to do, huh?
entries.uk: Нічний краєвид... Нічого кращого[n]не придумав, га?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, even though riding the[n]Ferris wheel is a cliché, it's[n]still fun to do it at my age.
entries.uk: Ну, хоч колесо огляду —[n]це банально, а в моєму віці[n]все одно весело.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hey... Are you sure about this?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: There are so many younger...[n]and cuter girls out there.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I know it's a bit late to ask, but... why me?
entries.uk: Знаю, трохи запізно питати, але... чому я?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: It was the same for me. When I[n]realized it, it was too late...[n]I couldn't help but love you.
entries.uk: У мене було так само. Коли[n]я зрозуміла, було вже пізно...[n]Я не могла тебе не покохати.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: What, so it just kind of...[n]happened? That's mean!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...Well, I guess romance is[n]like that when you're an adult.
entries.uk: ...Хоча, мабуть, у дорослих[n]романи такі й бувають.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I'm just going to thank my lucky stars.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Ooh, someone's being a tease.[n]It makes me want to force it[n]out of you.
entries.uk: О-о, хтось тут дражниться.[n]Аж хочеться вибити[n]це з тебе силою.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Let's see how long you can endure this.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: There's... so much in your eyes. I give up.
entries.uk: У твоїх очах... стільки всього. Здаюся.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I just can't help... how much I love you.
entries.uk: Нічого не можу вдіяти... я так тебе кохаю.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: This was such a great day. Thanks.
